It would advise against picking scabs, using rubbing alcohol, and touching the piercing unnecessarily, while endorsing methods like sea salt soaks and petroleum jelly application. The training covers both piercing and tattoo aftercare, with emphasis on keeping wounds moist, avoiding irritants, and seeking professional help if infection occurs.

It learned to distinguish between infection symptoms (redness, swelling, fever, pus) and normal healing (itching, dryness, scabbing). The training focuses exclusively on body modification aftercare and does not extend to other medical domains.
